description: Use this when a student asks what a question type tests, which skills it needs, how to practise for it, or what mistakes people make on it (for example "what does IELTS Writing Task 2 test?" or "what skills does PTE Read Aloud need?"). Give the exam and, if you know it, the question type by name or slug; without a question type it lists the exam's question types so you can pick one. Returns the skills the question type tests, the kinds of practice ScoreFluent offers, common mistakes where we have them, and a link to the ScoreFluent skill map. Do not use this to score or mark a student's answer.

questionType.description: Optional question type, by name ("Writing Task 2", "Read Aloud") or slug. Leave it out to list the exam's question types.
